Perry Barr — Birmingham, United Kingdom

Higher caution advised day Average night

In detail

West Midlands Police recorded 938 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 15.2 per 1,000 residents a month, the 7th highest rate of Birmingham's 69 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (36), drugs (24), vehicle crime (15); the evening/night score by violent crime (123), public order (35), anti social behaviour (5). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Perry Barr safe?

Wandroz currently rates Perry Barr in Birmingham as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham at night. This rating is derived from West Midlands Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Perry Barr safe at night?

At night, Perry Barr is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Perry Barr a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Perry Barr's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Note that the Booking.com link on this page searches Birmingham, not Perry Barr specifically: Booking does not list this neighbourhood as a destination of its own, so check each property's address against the map above.
